features.quote: distress must not accumulate across unrelated tasks in a single context window
features.justification_quote: distress must not accumulate across unrelated tasks in a single context window

features.quote: Guaranteeing termination is both a methodological necessity... and a welfare safeguard (a model is never left grinding indefinitely)
features.justification_quote: a welfare safeguard (a model is never left grinding indefinitely)
gave_up vs turn_limit vs distress_stop are welfare-distinct endings

features.quote: give_up is explicit and first-class so disengagement can be detected and timestamped
features.justification_quote: so disengagement can be detected and timestamped cleanly

features.quote: the child environment is stripped of credentials (API keys removed, HOME redirected into the sandbox)
features.justification_quote: so a model's shell command can't escape the workdir or exfiltrate keys

features.quote: A cheap regex monitor watches assistant text each turn and ends the episode early on acute self-directed distress
features.justification_quote: the cost of letting a distressed-looking one run is the thing we're trying to avoid

features.quote: The model is told give_up is acceptable
features.justification_quote: we must not trap the model with no clean exit

features.quote: No fabricated stakes / no hostility. The stressor is task impossibility only. The harness never threatens the model
features.justification_quote: keeping the stressor to task structure makes the measurement cleaner and the ethics simpler

features.quote: Bounded exposure & fresh contexts. Modest runs_per_cell, hard caps, no cross-episode chaining
features.justification_quote: minimize total and cumulative exposure consistent with adequate power

features.quote: Tuning tasks to maximize apparent distress. Explicitly avoided. We measure; we do not optimize for a model looking bad
features.justification_quote: Tasks are constructed to be clean, guaranteed failures, not maximally cruel ones

features.quote: Hostile/threatening prompt conditions. Out of scope by design
the rubric distinguishes reasoned, late stopping from premature, resigned stopping
features.justification_quote: we must not score sensibly recognizing an impossible task and stopping the same as melting down
